data.narrative:
ReOrbit, a Series A-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Sethu Saveda Suvanam, has raised €45M to date. The valuation landscape includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, though narrow peer filtering within Space & Aerospace yields insufficient same-stage data for robust median benchmarking.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised (€45M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-stage progression yields €90M. Public comparables in the sector trade at a median EV/Sales multiple of 27.4x across 6 tickers; however, this anchor cannot be applied without disclosed revenue figures, which private companies rarely provide. Peer-median comparison was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage private comparables meeting minimum sample thresholds.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of €76M (low) to €103M (high), with a median point of €90M. This range rests on a single quantitative method, rendering it sensitive to the assumed multiplier. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.0x step multiplier for ReOrbit's specific market conditions and burn profile, and the lack of revenue or comparable transaction data to cross-validate the stage-based estimate. Additional disclosure or market transactions would strengthen conviction in this range.
